print: SETTLED_CALLS.md 3b: the tape of record's mid at the market's `time` (first row at/after within 60 s) against `threshold`; the deployer's settlement is the print of record where pinned
registration: every active binaryPrice market on a declared coin in the pinned capture whose expiry is at least 300 s after the registration time and inside the call's day
rule: for each qualifying market: the side whose captured mid price is higher (YES if equal)

parameter.favorite: the higher-priced side at capture, one fixed parameter

burn_in.rule: PAPER until (i) at least 5 full days resolved and (ii) the leg's loss rate is below its control's on k_for(N legs alive) consecutive days (the frozen marker's k_for; N counts the legs on the board); then LIVE at the venue's minimum size by a dated amendment naming the account
burn_in.why: the panel @ 1:18:28: when the pass rate is low the episode teaches almost nothing; a leg must beat a coin flip before a fill is spent on it

kill.rule: RETIRED, sticky, when the leg's loss rate is at or above its control's plus 0.05 on 5 consecutive resolved days, or when it resolves fewer than 10 calls on 3 consecutive days; written before the first call (A35), never edited after a number is seen (S71)
kill.why: Musk @ 2:16:12: drastic action only when success leaves the set of outcomes; the set is written here

mechanism: the crowd's price as the call; a frozen rule chosen for its simplicity (S71)
frozen_by: PREREG A35, 2026-11-08; changed only by a dated amendment and never after a number has been seen (S71)
